examples.title: Gap Sizes & Responsive Gaps
examples.code:
<>
  <Columns gap={0}>
    <Column>
      <Notification color="primary" radius="radiusless">
        gap=0
      </Notification>
    </Column>
    <Column>
      <Notification color="info" radius="radiusless">
        gap=0
      </Notification>
    </Column>
  </Columns>
  <Columns gap={3}>
    <Column>
      <Notification color="primary">gap=3</Notification>
    </Column>
    <Column>
      <Notification color="info">gap=3</Notification>
    </Column>
  </Columns>
  <Columns gapMobile={1} gapTablet={3} gapDesktop={6}>
    <Column>
      <Notification color="primary">
        gapMobile=1 gapTablet=3 gapDesktop=6
      </Notification>
    </Column>
    <Column>
      <Notification color="info">
        gapMobile=1 gapTablet=3 gapDesktop=6
      </Notification>
    </Column>
  </Columns>
</>

examples.title: Variable Gap
examples.code:
<>
  <Columns gap={2}>
    <Column size={3}>
      <Notification color="primary" textAlign="centered">
        Side
      </Notification>
    </Column>
    <Column size={9}>
      <Notification color="primary" textAlign="centered">
        Main
      </Notification>
    </Column>
  </Columns>
  <Columns gap={2}>
    <Column size={4}>
      <Notification color="primary" textAlign="centered">
        Three columns
      </Notification>
    </Column>
    <Column size={4}>
      <Notification color="primary" textAlign="centered">
        Three columns
      </Notification>
    </Column>
    <Column size={4}>
      <Notification color="primary" textAlign="centered">
        Three columns
      </Notification>
    </Column>
  </Columns>
  <Columns gap={2}>
    {Array.from({ length: 6 }).map((_, i) => (
      <Column key={i + 1}>
        <Notification color="primary" textAlign="centered">
          {i + 1}
        </Notification>
      </Column>
    ))}
  </Columns>
</>

examples.title: Breakpoint Based Column Gaps
examples.code:
<Columns
  gapMobile={1}
  gapTablet={4}
  gapDesktop={3}
  gapWidescreen={8}
  gapFullhd={2}
>
  {[...Array(3)].map((_, idx) => (
    <Column key={idx}>
      <Notification color="primary">Column</Notification>
    </Column>
  ))}
</Columns>

summary: The `Columns` component provides Bulma's flexible, responsive grid container for aligning and distributing [`Column`](./column.md) components.

parts.summary: The `Columns` component provides Bulma's flexible, responsive grid container for aligning and distributing [`Column`](./column.md) components.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes for the columns container.

props.name: textColor
props.description: Text color.

props.name: color
props.description: Bulma color modifier for all columns.

props.name: bgColor
props.description: Background color for all columns.

props.name: isCentered
props.description: Horizontally center columns within the container.

props.name: isGapless
props.description: Remove gap between columns.

props.name: isMultiline
props.description: Allow columns to wrap to multiple lines.

props.name: isVCentered
props.description: Vertically center columns within the container.

props.name: isMobile
props.description: Apply columns layout on mobile and up.

props.name: isDesktop
props.description: Apply columns layout on desktop and up.

props.name: gap
props.description: Gap size for all breakpoints. Same scale as `Grid`'s `gap` prop; wins over `gapSize` if both are set.

props.name: gapMobile
props.description: Gap size for mobile. Wins over `gapSizeMobile` if both are set.

props.name: gapTablet
props.description: Gap size for tablet. Wins over `gapSizeTablet` if both are set.

props.name: gapDesktop
props.description: Gap size for desktop. Wins over `gapSizeDesktop` if both are set.

props.name: gapWidescreen
props.description: Gap size for widescreen. Wins over `gapSizeWidescreen` if both are set.

props.name: gapFullhd
props.description: Gap size for fullhd. Wins over `gapSizeFullhd` if both are set.

props.name: gapSize
props.description: Gap size for all breakpoints.
props.deprecationNote: Use `gap` instead — `gap` wins if both are set.

props.name: gapSizeMobile
props.description: Gap size for mobile.
props.deprecationNote: Use `gapMobile` instead — `gapMobile` wins if both are set.

props.name: gapSizeTablet
props.description: Gap size for tablet.
props.deprecationNote: Use `gapTablet` instead — `gapTablet` wins if both are set.

props.name: gapSizeDesktop
props.description: Gap size for desktop.
props.deprecationNote: Use `gapDesktop` instead — `gapDesktop` wins if both are set.

props.name: gapSizeWidescreen
props.description: Gap size for widescreen.
props.deprecationNote: Use `gapWidescreen` instead — `gapWidescreen` wins if both are set.

props.name: gapSizeFullhd
props.description: Gap size for fullhd.
props.deprecationNote: Use `gapFullhd` instead — `gapFullhd` wins if both are set.

props.name: children
props.description: Columns to render within the container.
